_doc: Practice bouts (SPEC 31). One host per mall (added to the mall by scripts/data.js, so the mall JSON is untouched) and four partners per mall. Stats are formulas: @lvl = the character's level, @prof = their proficiency bonus; floor/ceil/min/max allowed. Partner `after` = beat that partner once to unlock this one. Rewards: tier gp per win, at most weeklyCapGp per character per week. Voices: dm-notes/VOICE-GUIDE.md section 11.

galleria.name: Fenna Brackenbell (practice bouts)
pages: Fenna Brackenbell. Dunstan referees the real matches; I run the practice bouts. Padded gear, practice potions, and nobody goes home in a sling. Goolax pays me per bout.
Pick a partner. Beat one and the next will take you seriously. Wins pay a little from the Goolax practice purse, up to 250 gp a week.
ready: Whistle's ready. Who are we fighting today?
I taught tumbling to toddlers in the Rainforest Gardens until the rent went up. You're bigger. Same rules: tuck your chin.
Bouts stop at twenty rounds or the first fighter down. Then you shake hands. Then you drink water.
Your real sheet stays clean in here. Bruises are practice bruises. They don't come home with you.
galleria.capped: The practice purse is empty for you this week. Fight all you like; it pays again after your next match.

cogskill.name: Brassy Fenwhistle (bout timer)
pages: Brassy Fenwhistle, bout timer. Nineteen years timing ferries at Gok'Gok Harbor, so I know when something's running late. Practice bouts: padded, twenty rounds at most.
Choose a partner. Beat them and the next one agrees to see you. Wins pay from the Goolax practice purse, up to 250 gp a week per fighter.
ready: Stopwatches one, two and three are wound. Pick your partner.
Average bout today: six rounds, forty seconds. Beat it, or don't. I write it down either way.
My sister says timing bouts isn't a real job. She has never once been on time for anything.
Practice HP, practice potions, practice spell slots. Your real ones stay in your pocket.
cogskill.capped: That's this week's purse paid out to you. You can still fight; I'll still time it. It pays again after your next match.

galleria.name: Soggins
galleria.blurb: A soggy cardboard-lump Crud, born when a shipping depot flooded. Volunteers as a practice dummy. Says it's the most attention he's had since the boxes got wet.

moves.name: Damp Flop
moves.text: {foe} flops wetly at {pc}.

moves.name: Sag
moves.text: {foe} sags in the middle and has a little sit-down.

start: Soggins has been practising standing still. Soggins is very good at it.
hurt: Soggins is coming unglued. Soggins was always a bit unglued.
lose: Good hit! Soggins will dry out by Thoughtsday.
Soggins is flat now. Soggins likes being flat. It's like the depot.
win: Soggins won? Soggins has never won. Soggins must tell the other boxes.

galleria.name: Quinby Vamberkin
galleria.blurb: A Goolax intern who spends every lunch break fighting with a foam pool noodle. Has watched every one of your matches. Twice.

moves.name: Noodle Swat
moves.text: {foe} whips the pool noodle round.

moves.name: Sticker Slap
moves.text: {foe} darts in, slapping Goolax stickers on {pc}.

moves.name: Hide Behind the Noodle
moves.text: {foe} holds the noodle up like a shield and hopes.

start: I've watched every one of your matches. Twice. This is so much pressure.
My supervisor thinks I'm restocking lanyards. Let's be quick.
hurt: Ow! Okay! Okay. Pain is information. Somebody said that to me once and I've never forgiven them.
lose: Can you sign my noodle? I'm keeping it.
I went down in under a minute to a real brawler. Best lunch break of my life.
win: I won? Don't tell my supervisor. She'll make me do it at the next match.

galleria.name: Gorse Mudlark
galleria.blurb: A mushroomfolk wrestler, twenty-two years in the caves under Glister, retired to the Galleria for the light. Slow to speak, fast to grapple, kind about it.

moves.name: Cap Slam
moves.text: {foe} lowers his cap and charges.

moves.name: Spore Puff
moves.text: {foe} gives his cap a shake. A cloud of sneezy spores rolls over {pc}.

moves.name: Root Down
moves.text: {foe} roots his feet into the arena floor.

start: The lamps were worse in the Glister caves. You could only hear the other fellow coming. Begin when you like.
Hands where I can see them. That's not a rule. I just like to see hands.
hurt: Good. You're listening with your feet now.
lose: That was a clean one. I'll feel it in my gills tomorrow, and I'll be glad of it.
win: Rest. Drink water. Come back when your shoulders stop talking to you.

galleria.name: Dame Corvina Spindrift
galleria.blurb: A retired duellist with forty-one titles and one regret she won't name. Now teaches ballroom to anyone who'll stand still long enough. The Galleria's unofficial sparring champion.

moves.name: Riposte Flurry
moves.text: {foe} steps in, blade flickering.

moves.name: Whirling Hem
moves.text: {foe} spins, and her heavy hem sweeps at {pc}'s ankles.

moves.name: Second Breath
moves.text: {foe} steps back, straightens her collar and breathes.

start: Shoulders down. Chin up. You fight like you're carrying shopping.
I used to fight for titles. Now I fight for the company. Don't make it dull.
hurt: Oh, that was rather good. Again, and faster.
lose: Well. I shall have to tell my students I met someone today.
win: You were thinking about your feet. Stop thinking about your feet.

cogskill.name: Dent
cogskill.blurb: An old strength-tester cabinet that walked off its stand when the arcade upgraded. Still talks in score readouts. Likes being punched; it's what it's for.

moves.name: Recoil Arm
moves.text: {foe}'s spring-loaded arm swings back at {pc}.

moves.name: Recalibrate
moves.text: {foe} whirs. RECALIBRATING. PLEASE HOLD.

start: INSERT CHALLENGER. PUNCH THE PAD. BEAT THE HIGH SCORE.
DENT IS READY. DENT HAS BEEN READY SINCE OPENING TIME.
lose: NEW HIGH SCORE. ENTER THREE LETTERS. ...NOBODY HAS ASKED FOR LETTERS IN YEARS. DENT WILL KEEP THEM.
win: CHALLENGER RATED: NOODLE ARMS. THIS IS THE DEFAULT RATING. DENT DOES NOT MEAN IT.

cogskill.name: Brogan Galloway
cogskill.blurb: A goblin dockhand from the harbour who spars before the six bell. Fights with a boathook padded in an old life jacket.

moves.name: Padded Boathook
moves.text: {foe} jabs with the padded boathook.

moves.name: Rope Trip
moves.text: {foe} flicks a mooring line round {pc}'s ankles and pulls.

start: Shift starts at the six bell. We've got till then. Swing nice.
Mind the hook. The padding's a life jacket. It's saved two lives and it can save yours.
hurt: Oi! That'll bruise the colour of the harbour.
lose: Fair. Tell people you beat a dockhand. They'll ask which one. Say the handsome one.
win: Don't feel bad. I lift crates heavier than you before breakfast.

cogskill.name: Ondine Kettleby
cogskill.blurb: Eleven years on the Gok'Gok harbour patrol, now retired with a padded trident and a weighted net she won't stop mending.

moves.name: Padded Trident
moves.text: {foe} drives the padded trident forward.

moves.name: Net Toss
moves.text: {foe} spins the weighted net over her head and lets it fly at {pc}.

moves.name: Brace
moves.text: {foe} sets her feet and holds the trident crosswise.

start: Eleven years of patrol. I've netted smugglers, seals and one very confused bishop. Ready?
My net's been mended forty times. Every knot's a story. Don't add one.
hurt: Good. Keep that up and I'll stop going easy.
lose: Nicely done. You'd have made patrol. The pay's worse than brawling, mind.
win: Breathe out when you swing. Everyone forgets the breathing.

cogskill.name: Wobbleton Fizz
cogskill.blurb: A carbonated goo-folk brawler, undefeated on the Cogskill concourse since spring. Unofficial champion, official fizz.

moves.name: Fizz Fists
moves.text: {foe} pops out two wobbly fists and swings.

moves.name: Splatter
moves.text: {foe} bursts like a shaken bottle all over {pc}.

moves.name: Reform
moves.text: {foe} pulls the splattered bits back together.

start: Undefeated since spring. I'm also carbonated, so in the spirit of honesty: I might burp.
You've beaten everyone else? Lovely. They all told me. Goo hears everything.
hurt: Ooh, you knocked a bit of me off. Hold on, that was my good bit.
lose: You beat me! I have to go sit in the fountain and think about my life now.
win: Nobody beats Wobbleton the first time. Or the second. You've got lots of tries left.
